listed_quote.quote: Priority is a non-traded, closed-end fund registered as an investment company under the Investment Company Act of 1940.

announcement.quote: The purpose of this Supplement No. 7 is to disclose the Fund’s entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Priority Income Fund, Inc. (“Priority”), whereby the Fund would merge with and into Priority

deals.notes: Neither fund is exchange-listed: the target is described as having offered Class A, T, D, I and C shares in a continuous public offering with quarterly repurchase offers, and the acquirer as non-traded. For information, the merger was completed: 0001144204-19-025853 (2019-05-14) says 'Priority Income Fund, Inc. (“Priority”) announced today it has completed its acquisition of Stira Alcentra Global Credit Fund (“SAGC”).' Shareholders approved on May 6, 2019 (0001144204-19-024098); the N-8F (0001144204-19-028190) names Merger as the reason for deregistration.
